title: LOST IN TRANSLATION
style: art pop electronic, frustrated male vocal NZ/AU accent building to release, dissonant verse resolves to open chorus, glitchy production suggesting miscommunication, words cut off mid-phrase, space and silence used deliberately, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 104 BPM
lyrics:
```
[VERSE 1 — words cutting out, glitchy feel]
I said one thing / you heard another
I meant this / you gave me that
The gap between what I sent
And what came back

Lost — in translation
Lost — in the gap
Lost — in the version of me
That never made it back

[CHORUS]
Lost in translation
The context only lived in my head
Lost in translation
Said something, heard something else instead
Lost in translation
The bot moved on, the thread went cold
Lost in translation
The story you had — was never told

[VERSE 2]
Ten languages and still not right
The meaning slips between each byte
Not your fault — not mine either
Just the gap between the speaker and the reader

[BRIDGE — raw, half-time]
You don't know what it doesn't know
You don't know what it forgot
You think it understands you
It's just connecting dot to dot

[OUTRO — echoing, fading]
Lost...
In translation...
Lost...
In context...
```
